item.title: US Sailing: Building a stronger future
item.description: As a worldwide sport, Sailing is governed by an international organization - World Sailing - which has national federations such as US Sailing that looks after sailing enthusiasts within its country. But Sailing is also a unique sport which adapts to local needs that are administered at that level. item.description: The Practical Sailor publication has been providing practical advice since 1974, and in this report Chief Editor Tim Labute reveals four products and maintenance mistakes that routinely fail in their long-term testing, costing sailors thousands in repairs and wasted time. item.title: Records set at Match Racing Worlds
item.description: Ian Williams (GBR) and his Pindar by Manuport Logistics team of Gerard Mitchell, Richard Sydenham, and Jon Gundersen made history by winning a record-breaking ninth Match Racing World Championship title, held January 6-11, 2026 in Shenzhen, China. With 16 teams competing, Williams defeated Sweden’s Oscar Engström 2-0 in the first-to-two-points final, successfully defending his title for the third consecutive year.
